issues.current_text: O Irã rejeitou o plano de cessar-fogo americano e respondeu com cinco contra-demandas... O petróleo caiu 4% — WTI a $88,87, Brent a $100,40 — depois que Trump afirmou estar negociando com Teerã, algo que o Irã nega.
issues.previous_text: Trump enviou ao Irã plano de cessar-fogo de 15 pontos via Paquistão; um porta-voz militar iraniano respondeu que os americanos 'negociam consigo mesmos.' (03/25) | Trump anunciou uma pausa de cinco dias nos ataques... O Irã negou qualquer negociação (03/23) | Netanyahu ligou para Trump... O Brent recuou 11% (03/24)
issues.suggestion: This is the 4th consecutive edition covering the Iran-ceasefire-oil cycle. The new elements (5 counter-demands, Kuwait airport drone strike, UEB-1 interceptor) are real developments, but the surrounding framing — Trump claims talks, Iran denies, oil drops X% — repeats almost verbatim. Cut the 'Trump afirmou estar negociando com Teerã, algo que o Irã nega' line entirely (readers have seen this 3 times). Lead with the counter-demands and Kuwait drone strike as hard news, drop the oil price paragraph or reduce to one sentence.

issues.current_text: A SpaceX, em ritmo industrial, lançou 54 satélites Starlink em duas missões com 9 horas de intervalo — a 37ª missão orbital de 2026.
issues.previous_text: A SpaceX lançou 29 satélites Starlink de Cabo Canaveral no 27º voo do mesmo booster — a constelação já soma 10,9 milhões de assinantes em 159 países.
issues.suggestion: Routine Starlink launches covered 3 days ago. Unless there's a milestone (100th mission, new orbit, new country), cut this. It reads as filler. The NASA moon base paragraph is strong enough without padding.

issues.current_text: drones russos danificaram o centro histórico de Lviv — patrimônio UNESCO — e a ucraniana OSIRIS AI apresentou o UEB-1, interceptador de 315 km/h testado em combate com IA autônoma
issues.previous_text: A Rússia disparou 948 drones sobre a Ucrânia em 24 horas, um novo recorde; Kiev diz que interceptou 95,5% e retaliou com 389 drones (03/25) | Ucrânia atingiu o terminal da Transneft em Primorsk... 8.000 russos mortos ou gravemente feridos (03/23)
issues.suggestion: Ukraine-Russia drone exchanges have appeared in 3 of 4 editions. The Lviv UNESCO damage is a new angle worth keeping. The UEB-1 interceptor drone is yet another drone product announcement — the newsletter has featured drone products in every single edition (Skydio X10D, Draganfly SwarmOS, Netherlands drone units, BRINC Guardian, Shield AI/Destinus, and now UEB-1). Consider cutting the UEB-1 or moving it to the AI/tech section rather than burying it in the geopolitics paragraph.

issues.current_text: O petróleo caiu 4% — WTI a $88,87, Brent a $100,40
issues.previous_text: O Brent recuou 11% para US$99,94 — chegando a cair 14% intraday (03/24) | O Brent despencou 14%, batendo US$96 o barril (03/23)
issues.suggestion: Third time in four editions using the '[Oil benchmark] [verb of decline] X%' construction. If oil must be mentioned, weave it into the Iran paragraph as context ('o Brent, que já caiu 20% em uma semana, fechou a $100,40') instead of a standalone price-drop sentence.

issues.current_text: A Anthropic lançou o auto mode para o Claude Code
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic lançou o computer use para Mac
issues.suggestion: Same 'A Anthropic lançou o [product]' construction two days apart. Rephrase — e.g., 'O Claude Code ganhou auto mode' or 'A novidade da Anthropic desta semana é...' to avoid the copy-paste feel.

issues.previous_text: O Irã negou qualquer negociação (03/23) | um porta-voz militar iraniano respondeu que os americanos 'negociam consigo mesmos' (03/25)
issues.suggestion: Iran denying talks has appeared in three editions with nearly identical phrasing. Either drop the denial (readers know by now) or use a fresh construction — e.g., reference the 'pessoas como nós' quote as the denial itself, which is already stronger.

issues.current_text: primeiro tratamento para a síndrome de Hunter em 20 anos (AVLAYAH) | primeiro americana a receber tal rótulo (Anthropic)
issues.previous_text: seu primeiro processador para venda direta (Arm, 03/25) | primeiro voo orbital privado europeu (Isar, 03/25) | primeiro país da OTAN a integrar unidades de drones (Netherlands, 03/24) | pela primeira vez desde o início da invasão (NATO, 03/23)
issues.suggestion: The 'primeiro/primeira' superlative is used at least once per edition — 7 times across 4 days. It loses impact through overuse. Keep it for the genuinely historic (AVLAYAH is legitimately a first-in-20-years). For the Anthropic legal case, rephrase without 'primeira' — e.g., 'a Anthropic é a única empresa americana a carregar esse rótulo.'

issues.current_text: A FDA aprovou o AVLAYAH... Em edição de bases, o BEAM-302...
issues.previous_text: A Olatec Therapeutics iniciou a fase 2 em pacientes com Parkinson (03/25) | Na fronteira biológica, a Celosia Therapeutics dosou o primeiro paciente com ELA... A Fauna Bio atingiu marco (03/24) | a semaglutida oral fracassou em dois ensaios Fase 3 para Alzheimer (03/23)
issues.suggestion: Biotech/pharma closes every single edition as a standalone paragraph. This is structural repetition — readers can predict where the health news will land. Consider: (1) integrating biotech into the body when it's a major story, (2) occasionally opening with it, or (3) skipping the section entirely when it's incremental (phase 1/2 updates). Today's AVLAYAH approval is strong enough to keep, but BEAM-302 phase 1/2 update is the kind of incremental trial data that has appeared in every edition.

issues.current_text: a ucraniana OSIRIS AI apresentou o UEB-1, interceptador de 315 km/h testado em combate com IA autônoma para rastrear alvos
issues.previous_text: BRINC lançou o Guardian, primeiro drone com Starlink (03/25) | Shield AI e Destinus completaram testes de autonomia (03/25) | Holanda primeiro NATO a integrar drones (03/24) | Enigma Aerospace saiu do stealth com Phoenix drone (03/24) | Skydio X10D Army order $52M (03/23) | Draganfly SwarmOS (03/23)
issues.suggestion: Every edition features 1-3 new drone/autonomous vehicle products. The newsletter risks reading as a drone industry tracker. The UEB-1 is combat-tested and genuinely different (AI interceptor vs. surveillance/cargo drones), but the sheer volume across editions dilutes impact. Be more selective — only cover drone products that represent a category shift, not incremental product launches.

summary: Moderate repetition. The Iran-oil-Hormuz cycle is the worst offender (4th consecutive edition with overlapping framing). Drone products and biotech trial updates appear in every edition as structural patterns. The 'primeiro' superlative and '[Company] lançou o [product]' constructions are overused.
